risks.title: Litiges et charges de conformité
risks.score_rationale: Risque positionné en milieu de rapport avec langage direct (charges enregistrées de 1,22 Md$ en 2025). Tendance accrue : nouveaux litiges majeurs en 2025 (Omnicare False Claims Act 929 M$, PBM reporting 291 M$) vs charges stables en 2024 (100 M$). Catégorie litige = poids fort pour secteur santé.
risks.summary: CVS fait face a des litiges importants lies a ses pratiques passees, notamment des violations de la Loi sur les fausses reclamations concernant Omnicare et des pratiques de rapportage PBM. Les charges enregistrees en 2025 (1,22 Md$) representent une augmentation significative par rapport aux annees precedentes.
risks.citation: In April 2025, a jury found Omnicare and CVS Health Corporation liable in connection with alleged violations of the federal False Claims Act... the Company recorded a litigation charge of $387 million... During the second quarter of 2025, the Company recorded a charge of $542 million

risks.title: Deterioration de la rentabilite des assurances
risks.score_rationale: Risque en debut de section segment avec langage d'alerte (MBR deteriore, perte d'exploitation en 2024). Tendance accrue : segment Health Care Benefits passe de +3,9 Md$ (2023) a -0,98 Md$ (2024) puis +1,79 Md$ (2025), volatilite importante. Position strategique centrale du segment = poids fort.
risks.summary: Le segment Health Care Benefits, cœur du metier d'assurance, montre une volatilite importante avec une perte d'exploitation en 2024 et une rentabilite ajustee qui s'est effondree de 5,6 Md$ (2023) a 0,3 Md$ (2024). Le ratio de depenses medicales (MBR) s'est deteriore a 92,5% en 2024.
risks.citation: Operating income (loss) (GAAP measure) $ (984) [2024]... Adjusted operating income (loss) $ 307 [2024] vs $ 5,577 [2023]... MBR (Health care costs as a % of premium revenues) 92.5 % [2024]

risks.title: Devaluation d'actifs et restructuration
risks.score_rationale: Risque en milieu de rapport avec langage direct (charges de 5,7 Md$ goodwill impairment en 2025). Tendance accrue : impairment Health Care Delivery 5,7 Md$ (2025) nouveau, fermetures de cliniques Oak Street Health planifiees. Restructurations recurrentes (1,2 Md$ 2024, 0,5 Md$ 2023) indiquent ajustements strategiques continus.
risks.summary: CVS enregistre une devaluation majeure de 5,7 Md$ sur le goodwill du segment Health Care Delivery en 2025, refletant des difficultes operationnelles. L'entreprise procede egalement a la fermeture de cliniques Oak Street Health et a des charges de restructuration recurrentes.
risks.citation: Goodwill impairment (4) | | 5,725 | | | 5,725... Health Care Delivery clinic closure charge (5) | | 83 | | | 83... planned closure of certain existing Oak Street Health clinics in 2026

risks.title: Risques de conformite reglementaire
risks.score_rationale: Risque mentionne en debut de rapport (Item 1A, Government Regulation). Langage d'alerte implicite via litiges multiples (False Claims Act, PBM reporting practices). Tendance accrue : nouvelles violations identifiees en 2025 concernant des pratiques de 2010-2018. Secteur sante = poids fort pour conformite.
risks.summary: CVS est soumis a une regulation stricte du secteur sante et fait face a des risques de non-conformite importants. Les litiges de 2025 revelent des violations de pratiques de dispensation et de rapportage remontant a plusieurs annees, exposant l'entreprise a des penalites substantielles.
risks.citation: alleged violations of the federal False Claims Act related to dispensing practices by Omnicare from 2010, prior to its acquisition by the Company in 2015, through 2018... PBM direct and indirect remuneration reporting practices for two clients from 2010 through 2016

risks.title: Volatilite des resultats d'exploitation
risks.score_rationale: Risque evident dans les donnees financieres (milieu de rapport). Langage factuel montrant volatilite importante : adjusted operating income consolidee passe de 17,5 Md$ (2023) a 12,0 Md$ (2024) a 14,4 Md$ (2025). Tendance stable mais avec variations significatives. Impact sur performance globale = poids moyen.
risks.summary: La rentabilite operationnelle ajustee de CVS montre une volatilite importante, passant de 17,5 Md$ en 2023 a 12,0 Md$ en 2024 puis 14,4 Md$ en 2025. Cette instabilite reflete des defis operationnels et d'integration d'acquisitions majeures.

risks.title: Risques d'integration d'acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Risque en milieu de rapport avec charges recurrentes (117 M$ 2025, 243 M$ 2024, 487 M$ 2023). Langage factuel : acquisitions Signify Health et Oak Street Health generent des couts d'integration continus. Tendance stable mais persistante. Acquisitions strategiques = poids moyen pour risque operationnel.
risks.summary: CVS supporte des couts d'integration importants et recurrents lies aux acquisitions majeures de Signify Health et Oak Street Health. Ces couts, bien que decroissants, refletent la complexite de l'integration de ces entites dans le groupe.
risks.citation: Acquisition-related integration costs (3) | | | | 117 [2025]... In 2025 and 2024, the acquisition-related integration costs relate to the acquisitions of Signify Health and Oak Street Health

risks.title: Perte de valeur des actifs de soins
risks.score_rationale: Risque en milieu de rapport avec charge specifique (288 M$ 2025). Langage factuel : perte sur cession et liquidation des operations Accountable Care (MSSP et ACO REACH). Tendance nouvelle : divestiture completee en mars 2025. Impact limite = poids faible mais significatif pour segment Health Services.
risks.summary: CVS a enregistre une perte de 288 M$ en 2025 liee a la vente de ses operations Medicare Shared Savings Program et a la liquidation de ses operations ACO REACH, refletant une reorientation strategique du segment Health Services.
risks.citation: Loss on Accountable Care assets (9) | | 288 | | | 288... the loss on the wind down and sale of Accountable Care assets represents the pre-tax loss on the divestiture of the Company s Medicare Shared Savings Program ( MSSP ) operations

evidence: The Company is making concerted investments in emerging technology capabilities such as artificial intelligence (AI) to further automate, augment and improve its operational capabilities, and to improve the experience for providers, patients, and consumers.
The technology leverages assisted artificial intelligence to deliver insights to the business and bring automation to otherwise manual tasks.

The Company uses AI as an augmentative technology to minimize provider/payer friction, enable advanced consumer self-service through AI-assistants while enhancing human touch when desired, offer simplified health and care navigation, expand access, streamline and optimize internal operations and modernize operating platforms.
Canopy technology is a key driver of the success of its value-based care model and foundation for patients receiving a consistent, high-quality level of care.
ai_positioning.summary: CVS positionne l'IA comme technologie d'augmentation interne pour automatiser les opérations, améliorer l'expérience client et optimiser les processus métier (claims, pharmacy, care navigation) sans développer de modèles propriétaires à grande échelle commerciale.

company_description: CVS Health Corporation provides health solutions in the United States. The company operates through Health Care Benefits, Health Services, and Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segments. The Health Care Benefits segment offers traditional, voluntary, and consumer-directed health insurance products and related services, including medical, pharmacy, dental and behavioral health plans, medical management capabilities, Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement plans, PDPS and Medicaid health care management services. It serves employer groups, individuals, college students, part-time and hourly workers, health plans, health care providers, governmental units, government-sponsored plans, labor groups, and expatriates. The Health Services segment offers pharmacy benefit management solutions, including plan design and administration, formulary management, retail pharmacy network management, specialty and mail order pharmacy, clinical, disease management, medical spend management services, pharmacy and other administrative services. It serves employers, insurance companies, unions, government employee groups, health plans, PDPS, Medicaid managed care plans, CMS, plans offered on public health insurance, and other sponsors of health benefit plans. The Pharmacy & Consumer Wellness segment sells prescription and over-the-counter drugs, consumer health and beauty products, personal care products, and other general merchandise products. This segment also distributes prescription drugs; and provides related pharmacy consulting and other ancillary services to care facilities and other care settings. It operates online retail pharmacy websites, retail specialty pharmacy stores, compounding pharmacies and branches for infusion and enteral nutrition services. The company was formerly known as CVS Caremark Corporation and changed its name to CVS Health Corporation in September 2014. CVS Health Corporation was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Woonsocket, Rhode Island.
